metadata.description: Universal AI Plugin Marketplace — author once, distribute to all platforms

plugins.name: customizations
plugins.description: Route any agent-customization need to the right primitive — determinism-first — authoring the light ones and delegating the rest

plugins.name: dream
plugins.description: Periodic memory consolidation and self-improvement — "dream". Consolidates a one-fact-per-file memory store and surfaces recurring friction as proposed customizations to review.

plugins.name: dotfiles
plugins.description: Dotfiles management — chezmoi, fish shell, and environment configuration

plugins.name: spec-skills
plugins.description: Two model-invoked skills for software specifications: spec-audit (compare implementations, tests, or outputs against a governing spec and classify gaps) and spec-authoring (draft or revise thorough, testable specs with explicit scope, examples, and validation).

plugins.name: project-room-preparation
plugins.description: Organize messy project sources into an inspectable "project room" before drafting begins — source inventory, duplicate log, conflict log, missing-context list, and working brief.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Adaptive, host-neutral code review — detects the stack, routes to specialist reviewer lenses dispatched as agents with their own context windows, and records findings as SARIF.

plugins.name: product-led-eng-fleet
plugins.description: Run a product-led engineering fleet over a GitHub-issue work queue: a PM/orchestrator loop that ships work via self-contained issues, with implementer sub-agents that build against acceptance criteria and open PRs. The queue is detected by a deterministic git/gh engine.

plugins.name: github-fleet-tools
plugins.description: Opinionated, allowlistable command-line tools for an agent to engage with GitHub: read-only PR/issue-queue inspection plus bounded write verbs (label, comment, review reply/resolve, create issue/PR, guarded merge). Each wraps one gh op with no arbitrary-API escape hatch.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Deterministic local-git utilities for agents: exact diff statistics (meaningful vs raw line counts, implementation vs test split) and a stacked-PR manager (gst) for chains of dependent branches. Run the scripts for exact results — never estimate.

plugins.name: notebooklm
plugins.description: Turn repo files and links into a focused NotebookLM audio podcast you can listen to on the go — the agent picks the format and writes the host-focus prompt; aichatctl creates the notebook and starts generation.

plugins.name: liaison
plugins.description: Arrange a briefed, two-way voice conversation between a human and an AI session, then bring structured findings back into the agent's workstream — the agent syncs the docs, frames the talk for voice, and seeds a chat to continue on mobile. Powered by aichatctl.

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: Let the agent say short lines aloud through the speakers — status, a nudge for attention, or a one-line spoken summary. Uses macOS `say` today, with a clean path to vocli for real cross-platform TTS.
